messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P0 triggered for service=infra/inference-api-canary (deploy.canary) at 6896543210. Symptoms: sustained p95 > 800ms, 5xx spike ~20% of canary requests. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/rollout-canary

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident: #INC-88921 created and paged rotation (primary oncall @emma). Link: https://pd.redwood/INC-88921

emma: acked. I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now :coffee:

raj: looking at logs — new release build 2026-03-15-rc4 rolled to canary ~12:02 UTC. Top errors are "kv-cache-miss -> kernel-fallback" and segfault-like traces in the embedding path. quick grep: `grep -E "segfault|panic|fatal" /var/log/inference/*.log | tail -n 50` shows repeats.

trent: adding context: canary traffic weight 10%, consistent traffic from a handful of enterprise keys (enterprise-A, partner-batch). latency spike correlates with requests that use long-context embeddings (seq > 2048).

maria: customer-impact FYI: enterprise-A reported 2 downstream timeouts starting at 12:05UTC. Our telemetry shows ~2% of global requests routed to canary; of those ~25% erroring. Not yet widespread but visible.

emma: good. Next steps: 1) squelch noisy alerts while we investigate, 2) decide rollback vs quick patch, 3) coordinate PD acknowledgements. I'll squelch alerts for 15m to avoid autopage storms.

emma: `/squelch-alerts deploy.canary --duration 15m --reason "canary investigation"` (issued) :white_check_mark:

trent: running localized checks — reproducer against rc4 on local infra shows kernel mismatch when tokenization path uses new tokenizer-lib. Patch looks non-trivial.

raj: given the kernel/tokenizer mismatch, my +1 to rollback. Patch will need infra kernel tweak and model reload testing, which will take longer than safe for canary.

maria: +1 rollback. We should preserve telemetry for a quick postmortem (don't purge logs).

emma: ok rolling back canary to rc9. Command I will run: 
```
rdctl rollout --service inference-api --target-release 2026-03-14-rc9 --traffic canary=0 --reason "regression rc4"
```

emma: running now...

emma: rdctl output: `started rollout; adjusting weights: canary 10% -> 0%; traffic drain in progress`

trent: watching metrics -> canary request volume dropping. p95 for canary requests trending down but still ~300ms for draining sessions.

raj: I triggered the kube drain on canary pods to ensure no new sessions attach: `kubectl label pod -l release=rc4 bench=drain` and set readiness to false for those pods.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: Incident #INC-88921 status updated: acknowledged by emma at 6896543224.

oncall-sam: jumping in after ack — monitoring logs and external customer reports. Will take post-rollback watch.

maria: metrics update 5m after rollback start: global 5xx rate back to baseline 0.12% (was 0.95%), canary-specific errors near 0.15% as traffic drains. p95 overall down to ~130ms.

emma: can we close the PD incident once metrics stable for 10m and there are no open customer tickets? I'd prefer to wait 15m then close.

trent: agree. Also capturing evidence for RCA: snapshotting pod logs, rdctl rollout history, and kernel config diffs.

raj: saved logs to s3://redwood-ops/incident/INC-88921/ and flagged relevant traces in honeycomb: https://ui.honeycomb/trace?query=INC-88921

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty note: notify escalation policy paused while incident ongoing.

oncall-sam: 10m check-in: request rates steady, no additional enterprise timeouts reported. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then hand back to normal rotation.

maria: opened customer advisory to enterprise-A support with brief summary + ETA for RC4 fix ETA (TBD). Told them rollback completed and we are monitoring.

emma: rolling incident to resolved after 15m stable window. closing squelch. `/squelch-alerts clear deploy.canary`

pagerduty-bot: Attempting to resolve INC-88921...

pagerduty-bot: INC-88921 resolved by emma at 6896543292.

emma: resolved. Final metrics snapshot: global p95=128ms, global 5xx=0.11%. No further customer escalations. Will follow up with a short postmortem and action items: 1) pin tokenizer-lib for next rollout, 2) add canary-only kernel compatibility check to preflight, 3) refine alert thresholds to avoid autopage for small canary-only regressions.

oncall-sam: taking 30m watch, will file follow-up doc and hand off to next-day rotation. Thanks all. :heart:

trent: added labels: incident.type=deploy-regression incident.severity=P0 incident.root-cause=tokenizer-kernel-mismatch

maria: filing customer-impact partial report and notifying success-eng.

emma: good work everyone. filing RFC for canary preflight changes.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed (INC-88921).
